why: Why a consultation turn produced no advice, as a word. The server classifies every failed turn into
exactly one of these (ConsultFailure / ConsultFailures.Classify) and writes the word to the record,
the database (consultations.failure_kind), the caller kind's health file and the answer to the
calling AI; the panel's Consultant tab draws the label. The two halves ship separately, so a word
added to one and not the other is a failure the other side cannot name.
Neither half owns this file. The server's test reads its own catalogue by REFLECTION over the
ConsultFailure cases and ConsultFailureKinds and compares both with this list; the extension asserts
its labels against it from its own side (epic 5 of PLAN_the_consultant_works_on_every_vendor.md).
`givesTheCallBack` is the plan round's rule: every failure that was not the caller's doing hands its
consult call back — bounded per window — except `cancelled` (the caller's own choice) and
`tree-changed` (the consultant ran and broke the read-only promise).
